title: Ron Dennison's game-winning three for Cebu Greats dedicated to late grandma
summary: Cebu City, Philippines—Cebu Greats shooter Ron Dennison believes his game-winning three-pointer against the Batangas Athletics in the MPBL playoffs came with the guidance of his late grandma.…

blocks.text: Cebu City, Philippines—Cebu Greats shooter Ron Dennison believes his game-winning three-pointer against the Batangas Athletics in the MPBL playoffs came with the guidance of his late grandma. “Mao siguro na shot to tiraha kay gabayan ko niya,” Dennison told CDN Digital following Cebu Greats’ 78-77 win over the Batangas City Tanduay Athletics on Wednesday, October 7. (Maybe that’s why that shot went in because she guided me.)
